Both videos use a plain studio-like background with no set changes.
B has a slight greenish/off-white tint compared with A's more neutral light gray/white background.
Framing and scale are very close, with the dancer occupying nearly the same area in corresponding frames.
There are only tiny crop/position differences at some edges, not enough to affect the choreography match.
The low-budget isolated dancer-on-plain-background aesthetic is preserved.

uncertainty_due_to_sampled_frames: Low to moderate. The 30 sampled frames show highly consistent choreography and styling, but motion between the 1/6-second samples cannot be fully verified.
